summary: Lookout site on the St. Joe National Forest, Shoshone County, Idaho: camp 1939, L-4 cab 1942, destroyed 1963; labeled drive-in by Idaho Fire Lookouts and ground by the association; footings found in a June 2025 visit.

facts.design: L-4 cab with a patrol point on the northwest ridge
facts.status_note: Destroyed 1963 per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; a June 2025 post found four footings and metal and wire fragments.

staffing.status: no documented staffing history on Idaho Fire Lookouts

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-in; a June 2025 post says a road was blocked by downfall and the writers parked and hiked up.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: An earlier data read marked the site standing. Idaho Fire Lookouts says destroyed or removed, dated 1963, and its June 2025 post found footings. Recorded as gone, matching the association list.
Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site Drive-In; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Ground. The story reports both labels and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Status is settled by two sources plus the association list. Only one post (June 2025, Idaho Fire Lookouts) describes the site today, and it does not say whether the site is open to the public. The drive_up value rests on the site's Drive-In label; the association's Ground label conflicts with it, and both are recorded. The record's photo is already on file; no new photos were found.
